1.w: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

2.w: “Command the sons of Israel and say to them: My offering, My food for My fire offerings, an aroma pleasing to Me, you⁺ shall be careful to offer to Me at their appointed time.

3.w: And you shall say to them: This [is] the fire offering that you⁺ shall offer to YHWH: Two male lambs, sons of a year, unblemished, day by day as a regular burnt offering.

4.w: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the second lamb you shall offer in the evening,

5.w: and a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with pressed oil, a fourth of a hin.

6.w: [It is] a regular burnt offering, which was made at Mount Sinai for a pleasing aroma, a fire offering to YHWH.

7.w: And its drink offering [is] a fourth of a hin for one lamb. In the Holy Place as a drink offering of strong drink to be poured out to YHWH.

8.w: And the second lamb you shall offer in the evening. As the grain offering in the morning, and its drink offering, you shall offer as a fire offering, a pleasing aroma to YHWH.

9.w: And on the Sabbath day two lambs, sons of a year, unblemished, and two tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with the oil, and its drink offering—

10.w: [this is] the burnt offering for every Sabbath, besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

11.w: And at the beginnings of your⁺ months you⁺ shall present a burnt offering to YHWH: Two bulls, sons of the herd, and one ram and seven lambs, sons of a year, unblemished,

12.w: and three tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with the oil for one bull, and two tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with the oil for the one ram,

13.w: and a tenth part [of an ephah] of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with the oil for one lamb as a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a fire offering to YHWH.

14.w: And their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, a third of a hin for a ram, and a fourth of a hin for a lamb. This [is] the burnt offering for every month throughout the months of the year.

15.w: And one kid of the goats as a sin offering to YHWH besides the regular burnt offering shall be offered, and its drink offering.

16.w: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, [is] the Passover of YHWH.

17.w: And on the fifteenth day of this month [is] the feast; for seven days unleavened [bread] shall be eaten.

18.w: On the first day [is] a holy convocation; you⁺ shall not do any customary work.

19.w: And you⁺ shall present a fire offering as a burnt offering to YHWH: Two bulls, sons of the herd, one ram, and seven lambs, sons of a year, unblemished; They shall be for you⁺.

20.w: And their grain offerings [are] of fine flour mixed with the oil—you⁺ shall prepare three tenths [of an ephah] for a bull and two tenths for a ram.

21.w: A tenth part [of an ephah] you shall prepare for the one lamb, for the seven lambs,

22.w: and one goat [as] a sin offering, to make atonement upon you⁺.

23.w: Besides the burnt offering of the morning, which [is] for a regular burnt offering, you⁺ shall prepare these.

24.w: Like these, you⁺ shall prepare day by day, seven days, the food of the fire offering a pleasing aroma to YHWH; besides the regular burnt offering it shall be made, and its drink offering.

25.w: And on the seventh day you⁺ shall have a holy convocation; you⁺ shall not do any customary work.

26.w: And on the day of the firstfruits, when you⁺ bring a new grain offering to YHWH, in your⁺ Weeks, you⁺ shall have a holy convocation; you⁺ shall not do any customary work.

27.w: And you⁺ shall present a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma to YHWH, two bulls, sons of the herd, one ram, [and] seven lambs, sons of a year;

28.w: and their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with the oil, three tenths [of an ephah] for the one bull, two tenths for the one ram,

29.w: a tenth part [of an ephah] for the one lamb, for the seven lambs;

30.w: one kid of the goats to make atonement upon you⁺.

31.w: Besides the regular burnt offering and its grain offering, you⁺ shall present [them] and their drink offerings. They shall be unblemished.
